summary.text: Danica Noble is a Democratic candidate for the Washington House of Representatives, District 32-Position 1, in the November 3, 2026 general election, running against fellow Democrat Keith Scully for an open seat.

A consumer protection and anti-monopoly attorney who says she has worked at the Federal Trade Commission for over two decades, Noble placed second in the August 4, 2026 primary with 24.2% of the vote.

paragraphs.text: Noble earned a bachelor's degree from Whitman College in 2001 and a law degree from the Georgetown University Law Center in 2005.

In a Ballotpedia survey, she described herself as a consumer protection and anti-monopoly attorney with AI expertise, a union member and a PTA parent raising schoolkids in Washington's 32nd Legislative District.
She said her work has included litigation against Facebook and challenges to hospital monopolies.
Noble said her priorities include fully funding public schools, holding Big Tech accountable, protecting children online, and building an economy that she described as fair for working families.
Ballotpedia lists endorsements of her campaign from the Snohomish County Democrats and the National Education Association.
